build: Modwerk's linker: Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant 1c14b6b0) + this folder's Improved AMP 0.1.1-experimental (its exported package), materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version IA16

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: revision 2ac0f1f (the author's local build with a RAM-boot patch, which reproduces the 0.1.0 captures byte for byte); no card (starts formatted); JIT on; --every 1000M; DTBOOT_TURN_PNG after each turn, DTBOOT_STEPS with DTBOOT_PNG_DIR after each key

conditions: Cold boot; eight NO presses from 7003M, 300M apart, close the calibration notices. AMP page: AMP at 11003M (12M), 64 turns of DEC (encoder 2) by -6, 20M apart from 11303M, then 25 turns of HLD (encoder 1) by +6, 20M apart from 12803M (HLD 42). ENV RESET: FUNC + MUTE opens SOUND SETTINGS, four DOWN and YES, two DOWN to ENV RESET, one LEFT from FILTER to AMP. Captured on IA16 (0.1.1) on 16 Nov 2026: the three frames, and every frame of both plans (89 AMP page, 18 ENV RESET), are byte for byte those of IA15 (0.1.0) in the same emulator build. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified.
